thread:
incbot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate and timeouts across inference-gateway (eu-west-1). Observed spike in 5xx + 429s starting at 2234566980 UTC. Pager triggered.

marta (sre-oncall): I’m on it. Can anyone confirm a config change around quotas or ratelimiting in the last 30m?

raj (eng-runtime): I just saw a recent rollout to the rate-limit service ~2234566800 by deploy-bot. It touched tenant-policy defaults. Possible accidental global override.

deploy-bot: deploy:rate-limiter-service v2.14.1 applied by @lee at 2234566779

oliver (support): We're getting customer reports of degraded responses for embeddings and chat — some timeouts, some 502s. CS is triaging A-tier customers.

marta (sre-oncall): Ok first triage steps: 1) dump rate-limit policy for gateway 2) check gateway logs for 429->upstream-5xx pattern 3) open fallback route to lower-cost model variant. I’ll start with (1).

raj (eng-runtime): Fetching policy:

```
kubectl -n infra get configmap rate-policies -o yaml
# snippet
policies:
  tenant_defaults:
    requests_per_minute: 1000
    global_override: 100  # <-- suspicious
```

raj (eng-runtime): Looks like global_override was set to 100 in the rollout. That will cause aggressive throttling at scale and likely cascade to our autoscaler/backends.

marta (sre-oncall): That explains the 429 fanout. When clients hit 429, some retry logic is pushing load to fallback proxies which overloads backends (502/504). Starting mitigation: revert the rate-limiter config to previous value and open emergency bypass for critical routes.

lee (platform): Rolling back the config now. Command: `kubectl apply -f rate-policies-prev.yaml`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for configmap rate-policies by @lee at 2234567120

marta (sre-oncall): While rollback is in flight, enable the following mitigations: - increase gateway connection timeout - disable client-side retries via rw-routing header - enable cached-prefix responses for embedding endpoints

oliver (support): Notifying affected customers: sending status page update (drafted). Which tenants hit most? I’ll need a list.

raj (eng-runtime): Querying metrics to list top N tenants by 429 volume: `select tenant, count(*) from gateway_logs where status=429 group by tenant order by count desc limit 10` -> tenants: corp-alpha, corp-beta, partner-x. Sharing to CS.

marta (sre-oncall): Post-mortem note: this is classic throttle feedback loop: global override cut capacity -> surge of 429 -> client retry flood -> backend saturation -> 5xx. Root cause appears to be an overly permissive global_override in rollout.

lee (platform): Rollback completed at 2234567185. Rate-policies restored to requests_per_minute: 1200 and global_override removed.

deploy-bot: configmap rate-policies rolled back successfully.

marta (sre-oncall): Observability: I'm watching 5xx and 429 rates. 
- pre-mitigation 429s: 18k/min -> now dropping
- 5xx: peaked 4.2k/min -> dropping but some residual upstream 502s remain

raj (eng-runtime): Also put a temporary hard cap on retry rate at edge: `edge.retry.limit=2` and enabled jitter. Pushed rule to gateway.

oliver (support): Sent targeted messages to corp-alpha and corp-beta with mitigation steps and ETA for full recovery. Also updated status page: "Partial degradation—mitigation in progress".

marta (sre-oncall): Can someone run a quick health check against embedding backends? `curl -s -D - https://embed01.eu-west-1.internal/healthz` returns 200 for primary but some caches are still cold.

raj (eng-runtime): Running scaled-down traffic replays to validate. Results: error rate back to baseline under adjusted config. We'll keep slow ramp for 15m.

oliver (support): CS asks if we should proactively credit impacted tenants. I'm drafting proposal: 10% monthly credit for top-3 impacted. Request approval from finance/product.

lee (platform): We need a followup: block accidental global_override in CI (require codeowner approval) and add canary for rate-policy changes (5% traffic for 10m). Filing ticket: INF-4921.

marta (sre-oncall): Agreed. Also adding immediate post-incident action: add alert for sudden rise in 429->5xx correlation within 2m window.

raj (eng-runtime): For the postmortem: include exact diff from rollout, who approved, and a simulation of retry amplification. I’ll attach graphs.

marta (sre-oncall): On-call handoff: I’ll be online for the next 30m, then hand to lee at 2234567400 for follow-ups. If error rate re-flares, page SRE primary.

oliver (support): Closing loop with CS: Status page updated, customers notified, credits proposed.

marta (sre-oncall): Final status at 2234567265: 429s back to baseline, 5xx recovering. Incident classified: Sev2. Postmortem owner: raj. Next steps ticketed. :white_check_mark:
